title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Disputes over Financial Leasing Contracts

articles.content_en: 8. After the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation) provides that a state organ may not act as a surety, any guarantee made by a state organ shall be determined as void. If the invalidity of the guarantee causes losses to the creditor, the state organ that provided the guarantee shall bear the corresponding compensation liability.
9. If the leased property is purchased from abroad, the agreement between the parties to a financial leasing contract to pay rent in foreign currency shall be determined as valid.

10. Before the performance of the leasing contract is completed, if the lessee, without the consent of the lessor, mortgages, transfers, subleases, or contributes the leased property as an investment, such act shall be void. The lessor shall have the right to retrieve the leased property and demand compensation for losses from the lessee. If the lessee's void act causes losses to a third party, the third party shall have the right to demand compensation from the lessee.

11. During the validity period of a financial leasing contract, if the lessor unlawfully interferes with the lessee's normal use of the leased property or retrieves the leased property without authorization, thereby causing losses to the lessee, the lessor shall bear compensation liability.

14. Where the lessor is without fault, the costs and results of claiming against the supplier shall be borne and enjoyed by the lessee. If the claim is overdue or unsuccessful due to the fault of the lessor, the lessor shall bear the corresponding liability.

15. If a claim against the supplier is made due to issues with the quality or quantity of the leased property, and the lessor is without fault, it shall not affect the lessor's right to collect rent from the lessee.

16. If the lessee fails to pay part or all of the rent in accordance with the contract, it shall constitute a breach of contract. The lessee shall pay the rent and overdue interest as stipulated in the contract, and compensate the lessor for the corresponding losses.

17. When the lessee is bankrupt, the lessor may retrieve the leased property; or may apply to the People's Court that accepts the bankruptcy case to auction the leased property, and use the auction proceeds to satisfy the lessee's debts owed to the lessor. If the value of the leased property exceeds the lessor's claim, the excess shall be returned to the lessee; if the value of the leased property is less than the lessor's claim, the unsatisfied part of the claim shall participate in the bankruptcy liquidation procedure as an ordinary claim, or the lessor may demand payment from the lessee's surety.

18. When the lessee is bankrupt, the lessor may report its claim as a bankruptcy creditor and participate in the bankruptcy liquidation procedure; if the lessor's claim is guaranteed by a third party, the lessor may also demand that the surety perform the suretyship obligation.
19. After the lessor participates in the bankruptcy liquidation of the lessee, if its claim is not fully satisfied, it may seek recourse from the surety for the shortfall.

20. If the lessor decides not to participate in the bankruptcy liquidation procedure of the lessee, it shall promptly notify the surety of the lessee; the surety may report a claim for the amount of the guaranteed debt and participate in the bankruptcy distribution.

21. The limitation of action for a party to a financial leasing contract to request the People's Court to protect its rights shall be governed by the provisions of Article 135 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China.
